comment: Android Vulkan execution coverage, separate from the upstream entry classification. An entry may be added only with a real decoder path and a named test/evidence. Record-level evidence does not imply the full NVN object graph (tex_t/pool/view) is implemented.

nvnCommandBufferClearBuffer.evidence: android/tests/vk_record_test.c: OP_CLEAR_BUF -> vkCmdFillBuffer -> guest readback; device output vk-record: ok

nvnCommandBufferCopyBufferToBuffer.evidence: android/tests/vk_record_test.c: OP_COPY_B2B -> staging vkCmdCopyBuffer -> guest readback; device output vk-record: ok

nvnCommandBufferClearTexture.evidence: full clear + partial region (temp image copy) + channel mask (GPU readback/update/writeback); device RGBA8I/RGBA8/RGBA32I including INT_MIN/MAX/±16777217

nvnCommandBufferClearTexturei.evidence: android/tests/vk_record_test.c: OP_CLEAR_TEX INT full mip/all channels -> vkCmdClearColorImage; device sint=-128,-1,0,127

nvnCommandBufferClearTextureui.evidence: uint clear path not yet exercised on device; partial regions/channel masks are rejected by vk_record.c

nvnCommandBufferSetRenderTargets.evidence: android/tests/vk_record_test.c: OP_SET_RT state consumed by ClearColor/Draw; no-view full targets only

nvnCommandBufferClearColor.evidence: android/tests/vk_record_test.c: OP_SET_RT + OP_CLEAR_COLOR -> vkCmdClearColorImage; device rt0=26,51,77,255 rt1=102,128,153,255

nvnCommandBufferClearColori.evidence: integer render-target clear path not yet exercised on device

nvnCommandBufferClearColorui.evidence: uint render-target clear path not yet exercised on device

nvnCommandBufferBindProgram.evidence: android/tests/vk_record_test.c: OP_BIND_PROGRAM selects a registered Vulkan pipeline; prog_t/keys translation not yet implemented

nvnCommandBufferDrawArrays.evidence: android/tests/vk_record_test.c: OP_BIND_PROGRAM + OP_DRAW -> vkCmdDraw; device center=143,143,0,255 (hand-computed 8x8 uv); no vertex/UBO/texture state yet

nvnCommandBufferDrawElements.evidence: indexed draw path not yet wired

nvnCommandBufferDispatchCompute.evidence: android/tests/vk_record_test.c: OP_BIND_PROGRAM + OP_DISPATCH -> vkCmdDispatch with registered pipeline/descriptor; device first=1 last=190 bad=0

nvnCommandBufferDispatchComputeIndirect.evidence: indirect dispatch needs GPU-written group counts; vk_record rejects ind != 0

nvnCommandBufferCopyTextureToTexture.evidence: android/tests/vk_record_test.c: OP_CLEAR_TEX + OP_COPY_T2T full/no-view -> vkCmdCopyImage; device pixel=255,0,0,255

nvnCommandBufferCopyBufferToTexture.evidence: android/tests/vk_record_test.c: OP_COPY_B2T -> vkCmdCopyBufferToImage; device texture green=0,255,0,255

nvnCommandBufferCopyTextureToBuffer.evidence: android/tests/vk_record_test.c: OP_COPY_T2B full/no-view/row+image stride -> vkCmdCopyImageToBuffer -> guest; device red
